title: Charcoal Briquettes 8kg

adjustment.analysis: No events, promotions, or price changes in target week. The baseline already reflects recent trends and seasonal patterns. The 30% off promotion on 2026-04-06 lifted sales to x2.53 vs baseline, but the following week (2026-04-13) saw only x0.7, indicating strong post-promo dip. However, the noise-adjusted estimates for past promotions and post-promo effects are x1.0, suggesting these are not reliable drivers. Mother's Day (2026-05-04) drove sales to x1.59 vs baseline, but that was a holiday event. No such event is scheduled. The baseline median (49.4) is well-supported by recent history. No drivers justify an adjustment. The classical uplift model's 1.00 is validated by evidence.
